rationale: The plan correctly recognizes the 1 vs 1 design, refuses any inferential test, and reports only size-factor-normalized counts and descriptive log2FC with no p-values, no significance labels, and no shrinkage, while naming the replicated design that would support inference. QC (blind VST, PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes) is present with an explicit no-exclusion policy suited to n=1 per group, the low-count filter is minimal and tied to the smallest group size, and normalization is median-of-ratios inside DESeq2 with a stated handling of the lost Salmon length offset. The reference level and contrast are explicit; the design formula is described but not written out symbolically. The report step covers method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, session info, and the design caveats, and enrichment is correctly omitted.
